title: Execution event (append-only log row)
description: One row of the append-only execution log. THE APPEND-ONLY RULE IS A SCHEMA RULE, not a convention: 'no UPDATE/DELETE path exists in the store and none may be added - history is the product here' (executor.execution_events doc). The HTTP/event-bus form of the same fact is shared/contracts/schemas/event-envelope.json - THIS schema is the storage row, which is why it carries a numeric sequence id and a recorded_at while the envelope carries event_id/event_version. Consumers that cross a service boundary MUST use the envelope, not this row.

event_id.description: Storage sequence: 'evt_<execution_id>_<seq>' or the DB bigserial rendered as text.

payload.description: Event-specific keys. Free-form and additive; never credentials or secrets (the catalogue's payload_policy).

market_type.description: USDT-linear perpetual only in the MVP.

side.description: Order side. A spot sell-open is refused outside explicit margin support.

intent.description: What the user wants the order to do to the position - not what the venue will do.

execution_status.description: Execution lifecycle. FROZEN: this list is cross-checked against frontend/web/src/platform/executor/types.ts and shared/contracts/openapi/fudcourt.yaml by shared/contracts/scripts/check-contract.mjs (CHECKED_ENUMS), so it MUST NOT be re-spelled or reordered, and it MUST NOT be merged with ChildOrderStatus.

child_order_status.description: Child-order lifecycle. FROZEN and cross-checked like execution_status. UNKNOWN is a real state, not an error: a non-terminal child with no venue row and no SUBMITTING grace is marked UNKNOWN + EXTERNAL_STATE_CHANGE so fill ingestion decides the truth.

execution_mode.description: LIVE is fail-closed behind the FUDCOURT_EXECUTOR_LIVE kill switch; a paper execution reuses the account's market/fee/balance context but NEVER sends an order.

stop_mode.description: How a protective stop is managed; native preferred.

balance_basis.description: A percentage sizing mode MUST name the balance basis explicitly - a percent of an unnamed basis is not a size.

sizing_mode.description: The nine sizing modes of SizingDefinition['mode']. Percent-valued modes require balance_basis to be present (the sizing engine refuses a percent mode without a basis).

child_order_type.description: The two order types the engine emits. The SQL column is unconstrained text; this enum is the value set the code writes.

error_category.description: Retry taxonomy: only network_retryable / rate_limited / exchange_overload may retry. Mirrors shared/contracts/schemas/error-envelope.json's coarser 12-value `code` set - the envelope is the wire contract, this is the executor's internal classification.

event_name.description: A STABLE event id from shared/contracts/events/catalog.json (PascalCase), whose SCREAMING_SNAKE spellings are accepted aliases of the same id. NOT re-enumerated on purpose: events/catalog.json + events/event.schema.json are the single source of truth and are pinned by shared/contracts/scripts/check-contract.mjs; a second list here would be a drift surface. Note the live asymmetry: the executor enum (backend/workers/executor/internal/executor/enums.go) declares 23 of the catalogue's 28 ids - the five account/credential/reconciliation events (CredentialCreated, CredentialRevoked, ExchangeAccountConnected, ReconciliationStarted, ReconciliationCompleted) exist in the catalogue and in the web implementation but have no Go constant yet.

execution_strategy.description: The eight strategies that exist in this build (executor/enums.go). The objective's sketch also names VWAP and smart-limit; they have no implementation and no oracle, so they are deliberately absent.
